verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships an official, documented `ros2` command-line entry point with sub-commands for nodes, topics, services, bags, doctor and security, built on an extensible framework. It is included even in the bare-bones install and backed by a daemon for fast graph queries. A community comment confirms users rely on the CLI tools, but nothing in the evidence addresses agent-oriented use. Missing for 10: documented agent-friendly behavior (e.g., machine-readable/structured output or scripting guidance for AI agents), independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI-native workflows.
